Coordinate fitness for travel-time analysis

Source: R/coordinate_fitness.R
coordinate_fitness.Rd

Not every coordinate is fit for every purpose. A city centroid is a valid county or congressional-district locator and an invalid isochrone origin: a drive-time polygon drawn from the middle of a city is a polygon around a place nobody works. Geocode quality therefore has to travel with the coordinates and be enforced at the point of use.

Why it errors instead of filtering

Silently dropping unfit rows changes a denominator without anyone noticing, which is the failure this guard exists to prevent. In the midwifery workforce study the generalist population was once defined as "whoever happened to be geocoded" – 28,512 of a 50,556-person roster – and the missingness was invisible precisely because the missing were never counted. A loud stop forces the caller to filter deliberately and report the exclusion.
